title: [3.0-beta11] NSClient Synchronization
symptom: The setting 'Deliver this part of bolus wizard result [%]' is not transferred to NSClient, so the calculator on the NSClient side shows different results when this value is not 100% or not synced manually.
cause: The setting is not synchronized between AAPS and NSClient; settings must be done manually on each version.
fix: A commit was made to add synchronization of this setting (commit 80e65824a3939bafcb1986f1cfa737a5608a332a).
evidence_quote: Settings must be done manually on each version of AAPS (or NSClient version for remote monitoring) => You have to be consistent when you modify settings on one side if you want to have same results on the other side.
